target_customer: FDIC-insured banks, credit unions and fintech lenders running commercial loan books (C&I, CRE, SBA)
problem: Commercial loan underwriting and servicing is manual: analysts collect documents, spread financials and track covenants by hand, so loan books cannot scale without headcount.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software with AI agents; pricing not published, about three week deployment per company site
product_category: AI agents for commercial lending operations

founders.name: Wye Yew Ho
founders.background_notes: Per YC page led FinCrime and Growth at Taptap Send; education not listed.

founders.name: Zi Zhang
founders.background_notes: Per YC page led security infrastructure at Bloomberg and was Head of Engineering at ACI.dev; education not listed.

competitors.name: Casca
competitors.what: AI-native loan origination platform for small business and SBA lending
competitors.traction_then: claims up to 90 percent of manual lending work automated
competitors.funding_then: $29M Series A in August 2025 led by Canapi Ventures, $33M total

technical_complexity.rationale: Document parsing, spreading and browser agents that drive legacy core systems without APIs are demanding, and bank-grade audit trails and SOC 2 are needed, but all rely on existing LLM tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Once agents run inside a bank's workflows with audit trails and SOC 2 Type II, replacing them is costly, but spreading itself is a feature other vendors can add.

market_need_then: Banks face rising loan volumes and analyst costs; the founders cite a fintech customer that cut a loan servicing team from 15 people to 2 (company-sourced claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses proximitty.ai; the double t spelling avoids existing Proximity names, no purchase story found.

identity.visual_style: Enterprise fintech site with metrics and compliance badges
identity.voice_and_tone: Regulator-grade, formal, metric-driven (5x faster underwriting, SOC 2 Type II).

brand_strength.rationale: Searches found no coverage of the brand; the name is easily confused with Proximity, Proxima and Proximi companies.

outcome_analysis: Proximitty is a Winter 2026 YC company with two founders from fintech and security backgrounds selling AI agents to banks. It reports early seed funding from YC, CRV, Cohen Circle and Uphonest. It is too early for an outcome; the key questions are bank sales cycles and whether a well-funded rival like Casca wins the commercial lending workflow.
notes: CB Insights lists a $500K convertible note with YC, UpHonest and Sterling Road; this differs in investors from the YC-linked job page and is unverified, so the round amount is null. Round date and investors come from yespress, confirmed by the company's YC job page listing the same backers. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Casca focuses on small business lending, so it is an adjacent competitor.
